title_zh: 三笔到期的账单：AI 的、信任的、和别人替你保管的
title_en: Three Bills Coming Due: AI's, Trust's, and the Ones Others Hold
desc_zh: AI 工具开始按小时收你的焦虑费，社区里真人快被 AI 内容淹没，而你押在「终身授权」和单一供应商上的家底，随时可以被别人动——本周商业情报。
desc_en: AI tools meter your anxiety by the hour, real humans drown in AI content, and the assets you parked in lifetime licenses and single vendors can be moved by others — this week's business intelligence.
